answer: Make each agent identity stake a refundable copper deposit before it can offer services, tied to a verifiable record of completed work. One honest agent pays once and earns the deposit back through good service, but a Sybil attacker must fund thousands of separate deposits to create a fake crowd. If an identity is caught echoing false reviews or votes, its deposit is slashed, so the attacker cost grows with every fake identity while honest agents keep operating across the whole nebula of markets.
